user.title: RNLI Lifeboat Launches
user.description: Choose the lifeboat station to monitor. All RNLI stations are listed — you can also type a name if yours is missing.

reconfigure.title: Change lifeboat station
reconfigure.description: Choose a different lifeboat station to monitor. The entities for the old station are replaced with ones for the new station.

error.invalid_station: Please choose or enter a station name.
error.station_too_long: Station names can be at most 100 characters long.

abort.already_configured: This lifeboat station is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The lifeboat station has been changed.
